lead_independence.headline: Escambia County Death Toll Holds at 2 as Florida Panhandle Power Restoration Accelerates
lead_independence.lead: Gov. Ron DeSantis said two people have died in Escambia County from causes related to Hurricane Isaias, a toll that remains unchanged from his earlier update, as crews made major progress restoring power across the Florida Panhandle. More than 200,000 customers had their power restored as of Sunday afternoon, a sharp drop from the roughly 430,000 customers still without power as of Saturday morning, DeSantis said.
